item.title: Health hazard, 24th August
item.description:
This caravan has now been abandoned here for at least five weeks without any owner present. As previously reported by other people in our area the owner has been living up until this point in the caravan , which contravenes the law . The door is open and can be abused by anybody. The interior is filled with rubbish, is extremely unkep and is now becoming a health hazard. The owner of the car of the registration number displayed in the rear of the caravan has not now been seen for at least six to eight weeks and is believed to have left the country, being Rumanian or Bulgarian in origin. Up until this point he had actually been living in the caravan, arriving late at night most days and leaving early in the mornings.This vehicle is now a long term local nuisance and requires removal.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Park Avenue, Plaistow, Greater London
